**Subject: Executive Briefing proposal for Tamarack Instruments**

Dear Dana Whitfield,

**Situation**
Tamarack Instruments designs and manufactures laboratory measurement instruments and operates in the Netherlands, Germany and the United States. The Client has a customer service chatbot deployed on its support portal, is piloting AI visual inspection on its German production line and plans AI sales forecasting next year. An internal audit finding in June 2026 recorded no inventory of AI systems. Your stated objective is: "I want governance in place before visual inspection goes into production in Q2 2027."

**What the Briefing covers for the Client**
The Briefing maps the EU AI Act and GDPR to the Client's three use cases. These are framed as expectations to verify with counsel, including whether the chatbot or visual inspection carries specific obligations. United States developments appear only as general landscape items.

The readiness discussion reflects the Client's piloting maturity and treats an AI system inventory as a first decision point. We then introduce a governance operating model using the GRC Workbook (https://github.com/rolldabones/grc-workbook) and Slow AI Kitchen (https://github.com/rolldabones/slow-ai-kitchen). The board layer draws on AI Governance for Boards (https://github.com/rolldabones/ai-governance-for-boards) and the principles Slow AI, Informed Intent and Final Liability rests with the Human.

We will outline how this model could align with the Client's ISO/IEC 27001 ISMS, ISO 9001 quality management system and internal audit function. We will also frame preparation for ISO/IEC 42001, whose start date is not yet fixed. The Briefing does not promise certification, audit outcomes or regulatory approval.

Recommendations will respect two stated constraints. Customer data must stay in the EU, and the German works council is consulted before anything touches production staff. To confirm at intake: which use cases process customer data, and how works council consultation applies to the visual inspection pilot.

**Logistics and price**
The Executive Briefing is a two-hour live virtual session priced at US$3,000. It is designed for executive leadership and board-level attendees. The proposed audience roles are General Counsel, CISO, Head of Quality, Head of Data, German plant manager and two internal auditors. The session date is Unknown and will be confirmed at intake.

**What the Client receives afterward**
The Client receives a follow-up memo summarizing the decisions surfaced and our readiness observations. It also sets out three prioritized recommendations. Each recommendation is mapped to a next program option, either the Executive Workshop, the Practitioner Academy or the Implementation Accelerator, with a proposed timeline.

**Next step**
A decision is expected by 15 December 2026. We propose a short intake call to confirm the session date, the attendees and the questions above.

Kind regards,

Senior AI Governance Consultant
AI Governance Academy
